title: Nikon D780 24.5MP FX Hybrid Full-Frame DSLR (Best Full-Frame DSLR for Enthusiasts)
purpose: The ultimate hybrid enthusiast full-frame DSLR ('Best Full-Frame DSLR for Enthusiasts'): 24.5MP FX BSI CMOS sensor, EXPEED 6 processor, dual AF systems (51-point optical OVF phase-detect + 273-point Z6-derived on-sensor Live View hybrid PDAF with Eye-Detection), and 1/8000s to 900s exposure versatility.

sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 35.9 x 23.9mm FX-format Full-Frame Backside-Illuminated (BSI) CMOS sensor (24.5MP, 6048 x 4024)
sensor_and_optics.sensor_dimensions: 35.9x23.9mm FX full-frame BSI sensor (24.5MP, 5.94 µm pixel pitch)
sensor_and_optics.lens: AF-S NIKKOR 24-120mm f/4G ED VR (Versatile FX All-Rounder Constant-Aperture Zoom)
sensor_and_optics.iso_base: ISO 100 base sensor sensitivity (ISO 100–51,200, expandable to ISO 50–204,800)
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 14.4 EV dynamic range with large 5.94 µm BSI photoreceptors for exceptional low-light purity
sensor_and_optics.shutter: 1/8000s to 900s (15-minute long exposure) mechanical shutter, 7 fps OVF / 12 fps silent Live View

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Available natural ambient light, twilight blue hour, or long-exposure night sky illumination with large-pixel BSI low-noise latitude
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Rich full-frame tonal gradations with clean shadow recovery and natural color fidelity across golden hour, indoor ambient, and night scenes

surface_rendering: 24.5MP BSI full-frame pixel pitch (5.94 µm) delivering remarkably clean, organic skin tones, fabric textures, and architectural surfaces even in dim available light
EXPEED 6 color science with balanced mid-tone contrast and smooth specular highlight roll-off
Zero synthetic smoothing, preserving authentic environmental micro-detail and natural atmospheric depth
depth_and_optics: Dual autofocus precision: 51-point OVF phase-detection with D5 tracking algorithms and 273-point on-sensor Eye-Detection PDAF
Full-frame 35mm depth of field with smooth background separation and natural perspective
Extended shutter capability from 1/8000s action freeze to 900-second silky water and star-trail exposures

execution_directive: Enforce Nikon D780 24.5MP FX BSI CMOS full-frame fidelity with EXPEED 6 color science, large-photodiode low-light purity, and versatile NIKKOR F-mount optical rendering.
